openbanking.title: Open Banking Read/Write API specifications
openbanking.scope: API/schema reference; does not define a bank’s customer-service policy.

disputes.title: Financial Ombudsman: disputed transactions

complaints.title: Financial Ombudsman: banking and payments
complaints.scope: UK complaint handling; response deadlines depend on complaint type.

direct-debit.title: Pay.UK: cancelling a Direct Debit
direct-debit.scope: UK Direct Debit; not standing orders or card recurring payments.

fraud.title: PSR: APP scams
fraud.scope: UK APP fraud; reimbursement applicability depends on date, scheme and eligibility.

abuse.title: UK Finance: Financial Abuse Code
abuse.scope: Voluntary industry code; support principles, not an assertion that every bank is a signatory.

vulnerability.title: FCA: fair treatment of vulnerable customers (FG21/1)
vulnerability.scope: UK regulated firms; individual support needs, not demographic classification.

privacy.title: ICO: guide to subject access
privacy.scope: UK personal-information access; updated July 2026, do not retroactively apply new provisions.

crisis.title: NHS: urgent mental health help
crisis.scope: NHS England routes; confirm location before supplying local services.

debt.scope: England and Wales; protection concerns eligible debts and the applicable moratorium.
